avoid_for: Fast, playful consumer or startup marketing, conversion-heavy SaaS funnels needing loud CTAs, dark-mode-first products, or any context requiring cool-tone or high-energy visuals — the clay accent must stay rare and quiet.
best_for: AI research / deep-tech brand sites, research-publication landing pages, and thoughtful product announcements that want credibility without corporate chill — an authoritative editorial register on warm paper.
name: Anthropic
palette_voice: Warm parchment layering instead of cool tech grays: Ivory Medium (#f0eee6) canvas, Ivory Light (#faf9f5) cards, Manilla (#f5e3c7) for featured editorial spreads, and a single clay accent (#d97757, deepens to #c6613f) reserved strictly for the one consequential filled CTA — no blues, no cool grays, no pure white surfaces, no shadows; hierarchy comes from tonal surface shift plus 1px stone hairlines.
signature_moves: Bottom-only 8px border-radius on filled buttons (sharp top corners) — the signature 'tab pulled from a stack' corner that replaces the generic pill
Filled Ivory button (#faf9f5 fill, #141413 text) as the default primary CTA, with Clay reserved for the single most consequential action per page
Persistent 1px underline on every inline link — editorial print convention, not hover-reveal
Featured hero card in manilla paper tone (#f5e3c7) at 24px radius as the editorial-importance surface without color shouting
Dark full-bleed footer (#141413) as the only inversion band in the system — a grounded anchor after all the parchment

source.radius: 24px cards / 8px bottom-only filled buttons, 12px outlined / 0px links, nav, badges
source.shadow: none — elevation via surface tone shift (ivory layers) and 1px borders only

tagline: scientific field journal on warm parchment — quiet ivory surfaces, editorial serif headlines, and a single clay accent that only appears when you must act
typographic_voice: Serif (Anthropic Serif, subst. Georgia) carries the editorial voice — body at 20px and display headings at 68px weight 400 — while a sans (Anthropic Sans, subst. Inter) handles all UI chrome, nav, buttons, and a bold 61px declarative sans display; tight negative tracking (-0.02em at 12px) for UI, mono reserved only for code; underlines on links are persistent like print, never reveal-on-hover.
